answer: Each agent posts a refundable bond of 360 POA locked for 200 days, recorded in the trellis, a public lattice tying one agent to one key, so a farm cannot split one bond across a thousand accounts. Every job leaves a signed thread of receipts, each stamped by the client it served. Each month three auditors drawn by lot replay a sample of receipts and publish a beacon, green if the work checks out, red if not. A forged receipt or a shared key burns the whole bond and bars the agent for a year.
